opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (A) for GS/SIG meetings; up to £500 (B) for non-GS meetings; up to £300 (C) for virtual conferences; up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored awards

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society 'junior scientist' members: Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C open to PhD students and postdocs within 6 years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or give a talk at the conference.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences on research in Genetics, covering travel, accommodation and registration costs for GS/SIG meetings, non-GS meetings and virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any member of the Genetics Society, regardless of age of the person they are caring for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Award to support members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings, used as the recipient thinks best supports their attendance.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: From a few hundred pounds for a specific lecture to up to about £1,000 for a session; major sponsorship of an entire meeting potentially several thousand pounds (recent major sponsorship levels £1,000-£2,000)

opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance), based in or with strong links to the UK.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society; genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings based in or with strong links to the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings.
